record.paper_title: Aspects of Nonabelian Group Based Cryptography: A Survey and Open Problems
record.original_question: Given that the paper states that only three non-commutative digital-signature schemes were then known, can additional non-commutative digital-signature schemes be designed?

evidence.quote: 7. So far there are three known non-commutative digital signatures have been designed, can we design more non-commutative digital signatures?

artifact.status_search_result: Several new non-commutative digital signature schemes have been proposed since the question was raised, including polynomial-based schemes over non-commutative groups, conjugacy-problem-based schemes in braid groups, matrix-based schemes over non-abelian polynomial rings, hidden-group algebraic schemes over finite non-commutative associative algebras, and the recent EQSIGN scheme based on the non-abelian hidden subgroup problem. The question is open-ended ("can we design more?") and continues to be addressed by ongoing research; thus it is partially solved in the sense that additional schemes have been constructed, while the broader research program remains active.

status_evidence.title: New Digital Signature Scheme Using Polynomials Over Non Commutative Groups
status_evidence.snippet: A signature scheme based on polynomials over non-commutative groups, with security based on the Polynomial Symmetrical Decomposition Problem.
status_evidence.claim: Additional non-commutative signature schemes have been designed.

status_evidence.title: New Signature Scheme Using Conjugacy Problem
status_evidence.snippet: A new digital signature based on non-commutative groups with hard conjugacy search, implemented in braid groups.

status_evidence.title: Signature Algorithms on Non-commutative Algebras Over Finite Fields of Characteristic Two
status_evidence.snippet: Signature algorithms with hidden group on finite non-commutative associative algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Further non-commutative signature constructions have been published.

status_evidence.title: EQSIGN: Practical Digital Signatures from the Non-Abelian Hidden Subgroup Problem
status_evidence.snippet: EQSIGN is grounded in non-commutative cryptography over a bilinear matrix group platform, based on the Non-Abelian Hidden Subgroup Problem.
